topic: Analytics display issue for frame parameters
summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding an anomaly in the analytics display. Specifically, changes were visible and highlighted for frame parameters, but the actual values displayed did not reflect expected changes, despite information suggesting updates had been made last week.

Someone noted that while the visual indication of change was present, the underlying data values seemed incorrect or missing. It was determined that this issue needed further investigation to ensure no data was lost.
decisions: The display anomaly will be fixed in a future release.
action_items: Investigate the discrepancy between visible change indicators and actual reported values for frame parameters.
